title: zelenskiy says no trilateral peace talks before elections russia 2026 09 10
text:
KYIV, Sept 10 (Reuters) - Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskiy ​said on Thursday ‌there would be no trilateral meeting ​on how ​to end the war ⁠before the ​elections in Russia.
Zelenskiy ​said Ukrainian and U.S. negotiators were in constant ​contact and ​he hoped for progress ‌in ⁠talks on energy and grain at the end ​of September ​after ⁠his meeting with U.S. ​President Donald ​Trump.
Russia ⁠will hold parliamentary elections on September ⁠20.
